subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw change existing unset Docker sandbox configs to receive a default pidsLimit of 1024 on upgrade?
rationale: This is a security hardening improvement, but it intentionally changes a runtime default for existing users and the opt-out/config contract is currently inconsistent.

options.title: Approve the default with guardrails
options.body: Accept 1024 as the default only after the branch adds schema/docs/tests and real Docker proof that clarify upgrade and opt-out behavior.

options.title: Make the cap opt-in or doctor-guided
options.body: Keep runtime compatibility for existing configs and surface the PID-cap recommendation through setup, doctor, or explicit config instead.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and replace or close this PR until maintainers settle the sandbox resource-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the default with guardrails
recommendation.body: Accept 1024 as the default only after the branch adds schema/docs/tests and real Docker proof that clarify upgrade and opt-out behavior.
